facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes, freely; most foreign-exchange controls were abolished in the 1990s.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Not confirmed yet, though foreign-currency accounts are common at banks.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Local providers like Tranzila and Cardcom weren't researched yet.
facts.L1_registration: Open a file with the Tax Authority as osek patur or osek murshe.
facts.L2_tax_id: Your Mispar Zehut (ID number); how to register isn't confirmed.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Worldwide income taxed up to 47%, plus a 3% surtax at high incomes.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 18% VAT; osek patur freelancers below the ceiling don't charge it.
facts.L5_data_protection: Privacy Protection Law; most small businesses needn't register databases since 2025.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Reportedly 14 days to cancel distance sales, with a small fee.
facts.L7_incentives: Osek patur: no VAT below the turnover ceiling.

watch_out.text: The 2026 osek patur ceiling is unclear (₪120,000 or ₪122,833); confirm on gov.il.
Invoices above ₪5,000 before VAT need a Tax Authority allocation number.
